{"consolidated_memory":"Component: ui/components/DataTable.tsx (web ui side)
Problem: Blank render in data table (empty tbody with no console error)
Repro (all occasions): Open table with saved column layout

OCCASION 1 [2026-02-04]
- Trigger: Only when two requests raced on the same key
- Root cause: Off-by-one error in the slice bound
- Fix: Corrected the bound and added property test around it
- PR #5468 on branch fix/blank-render-1
- Result: Job finished in 67 minutes instead of 5 hours

OCCASION 2 [2026-04-09]
- Trigger: Only for payloads above roughly two megabytes
- Root cause: Schema drift between migration and model
- Fix: Regenerated model from migration and pinned checksum
- PR #8144 on branch fix/blank-render-2
- Result: Cold start dropped 32 percent to 959 ms

OCCASION 3 [2026-05-02]
- Trigger: Only after client had already retried once
- Root cause: Error swallowed by bare except clause
- Fix: Narrowed the handler and let the failure propagate
- PR #9967 on branch fix/blank-render-3
- Result: Throughput rose 85 percent to 345 requests per second

Note: All three issues occurred in the same area of ui/components/DataTable.tsx with context carrying over between investigations."}
